name: Park Jae-Hyun
bio:
Park Jae-Hyun's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during his mandatory military service. Assigned to a motor pool, his innate technical aptitude quickly shone as he meticulously repaired and maintained aging vehicles. This experience ignited a passion, leading him to pursue mechanical engineering after his service. Post-graduation, he joined a small rally team in South Korea, where his fabrication skills were honed under pressure. He moved to Europe seeking greater challenges, eventually landing a role at Hansen World RX Team.

Jae-Hyun's approach to fabrication is deeply rooted in precision and problem-solving. He's known for his ability to create innovative solutions to complex mechanical issues, often working independently to develop and refine his ideas before presenting them to the team. His unwavering commitment to quality and his eye for detail set him apart, making him a valued asset in a high-stakes environment. His unique ability to visualize and implement improvements makes him a distinctive member of the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: He has a wiry build and often wears safety glasses perched on his forehead.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his wrench against metal surfaces to test their resonance.
Insists on using a specific brand of Japanese measuring tape for all his work.
